newsitem.title: UK: Paris overtakes London in millionaire businesses. [corrected 03:02 gmt 7/11]
newsitem.headline: Paris overtakes London in millionaire businesses. [corrected 03:02 gmt 7/11]

text.p: Paris has overtaken London as the European city with the most millionaire businesses, a survey published on Wednesday (corrects from Thursday) said.

Business information company Dun & Bradstreet's (D&B) guide to 63,000 top businesses in Europe, Turkey and Israel put Paris top with 1,750 businesses earning more than one million ECUs ($1.3 million) in sales a year followed by London with 1,700.

"The companies in this guide are the leading players across the European business scene. Paris, which has often headed the European league for fashion, now emerges as the number one centre for large businesses," Angela Norton, D&B's marketing director, said in a statement.
The latest figures reversed last year's table which had London top with 1,550 firms, compared to 1,500 in Paris.
Madrid and Milan took third and fourth this year, each with more than 1,000 millionaire businesses, followed by Hamburg, Vienna, Istanbul, Munich, Barcelona and Rome.
